scope: Deterministic state reconstruction of the accepted heuristic recording. No policy execution or new episode sampling.

semantics.frames: Frame 0 is reset state; frame n is the state after recorded action n. Stop at done, including a goal where frog.alive remains true.
semantics.coordinates: Grid coordinates: x increases right, y increases down; tiles[y][x]. Object x and speed retain native floating-point values. Length is measured in tiles. Only active cars and logs are exported.
semantics.rendering: Browser may show fractional object extents clipped at board edges. Native renderer truncates object x toward zero into occupied display cells; this is not native visual equivalence. No modulo wrapping or interpolated simulation is implied.
semantics.timing: One snapshot per simulation step. Playback speed is presentation only.

limits: Illustrative heuristic replay, not trained neuro performance.
No new training, policy evaluation, holdout, native GUI or visual acceptance.
